entries.name: JobTask
entries.declaration: Class JobTask (Job : JobType) (Task : TaskType) := job_task : Job -> Task.

entries.name: TaskDeadline
entries.declaration: Class TaskDeadline (Task : TaskType) := task_deadline : Task -> duration.

entries.name: TaskCost
entries.declaration: Class TaskCost (Task : TaskType) := task_cost : Task -> duration.

entries.name: valid_job_cost
entries.declaration:
Definition valid_job_cost j :=
      job_cost j <= task_cost (job_task j).

entries.name: SporadicModel
entries.declaration:
Class SporadicModel (Task : TaskType) :=
  task_min_inter_arrival_time : Task -> duration.

entries.name: respects_sporadic_task_model
entries.declaration:
Definition respects_sporadic_task_model (tsk : Task) :=
    forall (j j' : Job),
      
      j <> j' ->
      
      arrives_in arr_seq j ->
      arrives_in arr_seq j' ->
      
      job_task j = tsk ->
      job_task j' = tsk ->
      
      job_arrival j <= job_arrival j' ->
      

      job_arrival j' >= job_arrival j + task_min_inter_arrival_time tsk.

entries.name: EDF
job_deadline_from_task_deadline
entries.declaration:
Instance job_deadline_from_task_deadline (Job : JobType) (Task : TaskType)
         `{TaskDeadline Task} `{JobArrival Job} `{JobTask Job Task} : JobDeadline Job :=
  fun (j : Job) => job_arrival j + task_deadline (job_task j).

entries.name: task_demand_bound_function
entries.declaration:
Definition task_demand_bound_function (tsk : Task) (delta : duration) :=
    let delta' := delta - (task_deadline tsk - 1) in
      task_request_bound_function tsk delta'.

entries.name: total_demand_bound_function
entries.declaration:
Definition total_demand_bound_function (ts : seq Task) (delta : duration) :=
    \sum_(tsk <- ts) task_demand_bound_function tsk delta.

entries.name: total_demand_within_le_total_dbf
entries.declaration:
Lemma total_demand_within_le_total_dbf :
    forall (t : instant) (delta : duration),
      total_demand_within t (t + delta) <= total_demand_bound_function ts delta.
